body:
## Pull request overview

Unifies stack composition across the repo by removing the duplicate `composeStacks` implementation in `@object-ui/core` and switching call sites to the canonical `composeStacks` from `@objectstack/spec`, with a small post-compose adapter to preserve runtime `listViews` behavior.

**Changes:**
- Deleted `@object-ui/core`’s `composeStacks` utility and its associated test suite.
- Switched composition in `objectstack.config.ts` and `apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts` to `composeStacks` from `@objectstack/spec`, manually aggregating seed data.
- Introduced `mergeViewsIntoObjects()` as a shared adapter and re-exported it from `@object-ui/core`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/core/src/utils/merge-views-into-objects.ts | Adds adapter to merge `views[].listViews` onto matching object definitions post-compose. |
| packages/core/src/utils/compose-stacks.ts | Removes the now-duplicate core `composeStacks` implementation. |
| packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/compose-stacks.test.ts | Removes the unit tests that previously validated core composition behavior. |
| packages/core/src/index.ts | Drops `composeStacks` export and re-exports `mergeViewsIntoObjects`. |
| objectstack.config.ts | Uses `@objectstack/spec` `composeStacks`, aggregates seed data, then merges views into objects. |
| apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts | Same composition switch + seed data aggregation + views→objects adapter for console shared config. |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates roadmap language to reflect the unified `composeStacks` approach. |
</details>

This ROADMAP section still lists the composeStacks unit test suite as completed, but the PR removes that test file along with the core implementation. Consider rewording the surrounding checklist items so the ROADMAP doesn’t imply those tests still exist in-repo (or note explicitly that coverage now lives upstream in @objectstack/spec).

This new utils file is missing the standard ObjectUI MIT license header comment that other `@object-ui/core` source files include. Add the same header block for consistency and to ensure the licensing notice is preserved when files are copied around.

`mergeViewsIntoObjects` introduces behavior that used to be covered by the removed composeStacks test suite, but there are no unit tests for this helper. Add a small test file under `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__` to cover merging behavior (merges views by object, preserves existing object.listViews, ignores listViews without data.object).

Removing the `composeStacks` re-export from `@object-ui/core` is a breaking public API change for downstream consumers importing it from this package. Add a changeset (likely major) or keep a deprecated re-export that forwards to `@objectstack/spec` with a clear migration note, so releases don’t silently break external users.
```suggestion
export * from './protocols/index.js';

/**
 * @deprecated Please import `composeStacks` from `@objectstack/spec` instead.
 *
 * This re-export is kept only for backward compatibility and will be removed
 * in the next major version of `@object-ui/core`.
 */
export { composeStacks } from '@objectstack/spec';
```
